title: Practice: Lead Uppercut Elbow
source: Practice Mode tutorial. The move is in the app's Technique Library (practiceData.js › Muay Thai › Lead Uppercut Elbow: cues, mistakes, next), named from the owner's footage by Claude; the owner corrects the name at approval. Thai: Sok Ngat (ศอกงัด). Footage: the owner's clip 4 (ring, 2026-10-31), raw-footage/practice/p4.mp4. One shot; four reps with the lead elbow rising at about 0.65, 2.6, 4.5 and 6.85 s.

props.description: The rising elbow under the chin, lead side
props.hookSub: Lead uppercut elbow. Sok Ngat. 20 seconds.

cues.text: Drop the hand, point the elbow up
cues.label: DROP
cues.say: Coach: "The hand dips first, so the point of the elbow leads the way up."

cues.label: LEGS
cues.say: Coach: "The legs straighten into it. That's where the lift comes from."

cues.label: FINISH
cues.say: Coach: "Follow through until the hand is past your ear. Short of that, it's a nudge."

watch.label: SHOULDER
watch.say: Coach: "Shoulder only and it's an arm strike. Legs and hip, and it lifts their head."
